name: Cheech & Chong - Singles - Cryo Infused Pre-Roll - Ajax Haze (S)
description:
One joint, extra kick. The Cheech & Chong Ajax Haze single is a cryo-infused pre-roll packed with quality flower and infused with distillate for a bolder, more potent smoke. No grinding, no rolling, no setup. Just light it and go.

Ajax Haze brings a bright, classic Haze profile: zesty citrus and sweet herbal notes up front, layered with a peppery-spicy edge and a smooth, earthy finish. Blended with a sativa terpene profile for an uplifting, energizing feel — clear-headed and fast-moving, made for daytime and staying productive.

Why you'll love it:

Cryo-infused pre-roll — quality flower infused with distillate for extra potency
Cryo-infusion process — locks in flavor and delivers a smooth, even burn
Signature Ajax Haze flavor — zesty citrus and sweet herbs with a peppery finish
Sativa effects — uplifting and energizing, ideal for daytime
Cheech & Chong — a name that's been in the game since day one

Big flavor, dependable potency, and effortless convenience in every joint. Cheech & Chong Ajax Haze is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
